title: In nfa_t4tnfcee_store_rx_buf of nfa_nfcee_act.cc, there is a possible way to achieve code execution… (CVE-2026-55261)
description: A vulnerability exists in the function nfa_t4tnfcee_store_rx_buf within the source file nfa_nfcee_act.cc, where a missing permission check may allow code execution. This flaw could enable local privilege escalation without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
